title: ChatCLI Operator Helm Chart Values
description: JSON Schema for validating the values.yaml of the chatcli-operator Helm chart.

replicaCount.description: Number of operator pod replicas. Every replica serves the REST API and dashboard; the reconcilers and the alert bridge run on the leader.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion if empty.

imagePullSecrets.description: List of Docker registry pull secrets.

leaderElect.description: Enable leader election (lease chatcli-operator-lock). Keep it on with more than one replica.

prometheusUrl.description: URL of the Prometheus instance to query for metrics.

create.description: Whether to create a service account.

name.description: Name of the service account. If not set and create is true, a name is generated.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

crdUpgrade.description: Pre-install/pre-upgrade hook that re-applies CRDs on every Helm upgrade. Helm only applies files from the chart's crds/ directory on first install; this hook closes that gap so the CRD schema stays in sync with the controller binary across version bumps.

enabled.description: Whether to install the CRD upgrade hook. Disable only when managing CRDs out of band (separate chart, GitOps, etc.).

image.description: Container image for the kubectl-apply Job that ships with the hook.

repository.description: Image repository. Defaults to the official Kubernetes-project distroless kubectl image at registry.k8s.io.

tag.description: Image tag. Must be a fully-qualified patch tag (e.g. v1.31.10) — major-minor stubs like v1.31 are NOT resolvable on registry.k8s.io.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the hook Job pod.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the hook Job pod.

nodeSelector.description: NodeSelector for the hook Job pod.

resources.description: CPU and memory resource requests and limits.

runAsNonRoot.description: Require the pod to run as a non-root user.

runAsUser.description: UID to run the pod as.

runAsGroup.description: GID to run the pod as.

localhostProfile.description: Path to a localhost seccomp profile.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether the container can gain more privileges than its parent.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Mount the root filesystem as read-only.

runAsNonRoot.description: Require the container to run as non-root.

runAsUser.description: UID to run the container as.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector labels for pod scheduling.

enabled.description: Whether to create a ServiceMonitor resource.

scrapeTimeout.description: Scrape timeout. Must be less than the interval.

alertTransport.description: How the operator receives watcher alerts: stream keeps a StreamAlerts stream open and polls only while the server lacks the RPC; poll queries GetAlerts every 30s.

enabled.description: Gate every RemediationPlan on adjusted AI confidence, severity and a per-namespace circuit breaker; plans that do not pass wait for a human.

clusterName.description: This cluster's ClusterRegistration name; its tier decides which severities wait for a human. A name no registration carries sends every plan to manual approval.

security.description: Security hardening configuration for the operator.

devMode.description: Dev mode: while no API key is configured, the REST API admits every call as admin. NEVER use in production.

apiTLS.description: TLS 1.3 for the REST API and dashboard. Paths inside the container; mount the Secret with extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts.

grpcTLS.description: Operator-wide TLS material for dialing ChatCLI servers (absolute paths inside the container). Per-Instance ca.crt / operatorClientCertSecretName take precedence.

allowedResourceTypes.description: Extra comma-separated resource kinds remediation may touch, added to the 16 built-in defaults. The operator ClusterRole must also allow the kind.

logScrubPatterns.description: Comma-separated custom regex patterns for log scrubbing.

allowedDiagnosticCommands.description: Comma-separated extra read-only diagnostic commands allowed for remediation (appended to the built-in allowlist). Read by the operator process, not by Instances.

corsOrigin.description: CORS allowed origin. Empty = deny all (default).

auditLogPath.description: DEPRECATED and ignored: the operator no longer reads CHATCLI_AUDIT_LOG_PATH and the chart no longer renders it. Accepted only so existing values files keep validating.

corsAllowedOrigins.description: Origins allowed to call the operator REST API from a browser.

corsAllowedMethods.description: HTTP methods allowed cross-origin; defaults to GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS.

corsAllowCredentials.description: Allow cookies and Authorization on cross-origin requests.

apiKeys.description: REST API / dashboard keys. With create=true the chart renders the Secret chatcli-operator-secrets (key api-keys) the operator reads; its name is fixed.

create.description: Render the chatcli-operator-secrets Secret from entries.

entries.description: API keys: key (the X-API-Key value), role (viewer, operator or admin), optional name and description.

name.description: Identity recorded on the approval decisions taken with this key (falls back to description).

networkPolicy.description: Optional NetworkPolicy for the operator pod.

apiIngressFrom.description: NetworkPolicyPeer list allowed to reach the REST API/dashboard port. Empty = any source.

metricsIngressFrom.description: NetworkPolicyPeer list allowed to reach the metrics port. Empty = any source.

egress.description: restricted: DNS, 443, the Kubernetes API port, the Instances' gRPC port, the prometheusUrl port and egressExtraPorts. allowAll: no egress restriction.

kubernetesApiPort.description: Kubernetes API server port allowed on egress.

instanceGrpcPort.description: gRPC port of the managed Instances (spec.server.port).

egressExtraPorts.description: Extra egress ports when egress is restricted (SMTP, git over SSH, webhooks on other ports).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the operator pod.

extraVolumes.description: Extra pod volumes (core/v1 Volume objects), e.g. Secrets behind security.apiTLS / security.grpcTLS paths.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the manager container (core/v1 VolumeMount objects).

tmpVolume.description: The writable /tmp of the operator pod (emptyDir; the root filesystem is read-only). SourceRepository clones and per-sync git credential files live there.

sizeLimit.description: emptyDir size limit, a Kubernetes quantity. Size it for the SourceRepository clones (shallow, depth 50).
